 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Oct 28, 2026, 15:40:38 IST SUMMARY India vs Zimbabwe Women 3rd ODI Live Score: A dominant India will look to sign off their first-ever bilateral women's ODI series against Zimbabwe with another emphatic win when the two teams square off in the third and final 50-over game in Vadodara on Wednesday. 
 India have already clinched the series with an unassailable 2-0 lead after comprehensive victories in the first two games. They will now aim for a clean sweep to top up a 3-0 T20I series triumph earlier this month. 
 The hosts have barely been challenged across the two ODI outings. Pratika Rawal's unbeaten 100 and Shree Charani's four-wicket haul set up a nine-wicket win in the opener before Harmanpreet Kaur's 126 and Deepti Sharma's unbeaten 106 powered India to 328 for six in the second match. 
 India, led by young left-arm spinner Vaishnavi Sharma, then bowled Zimbabwe out for 207 to register a comprehensive 121-run victory and seal the series with a game to spare. 
 While Smriti Mandhana has started her full-time captaincy stint on a strong note, the opener would ideally like to make a big knock before the series ends. 
 She was dismissed after scoring 32 against the run of play in the opener while getting out for a duck in the second match. Commentary

 133 More Updates Load More Harmanpreet's return to form has perhaps been the biggest positive for the Women in Blue. The senior batter rolled back the years with a commanding, match-winning century in the second ODI.
The bowling department has done its job but could perhaps be more ruthless against a lower-ranked team like Zimbabwe.
Shree Charani's career-best 4/23 in the first ODI was followed by a four-wicket haul by young left-arm spinner Vaishnavi Sharma in the second, with Deepti also picking up three wickets.
For Zimbabwe, the third ODI presents a final opportunity to put up a stronger fight. Their batters have struggled to build sizeable partnerships against India's varied attack, while the bowlers face another stern test against a deep Indian line-up.
